name: Luzid Backup to Nextcloud
author: luzidmedia

sections.description:
Luzid Backup to Nextcloud uploads your existing WordPress backup files to a Nextcloud folder via WebDAV.

It is designed for two main workflows:

1) Automate offsite copies: upload backup archives on a schedule (WordPress Cron)
2) Manual runs + monitoring: start uploads manually and follow progress + logs

Typical use cases:

  • Keep an offsite copy of backup archives generated by popular backup plugins.
  • Upload backups to a structured Nextcloud folder (per source).
  • Reduce storage usage with optional rotation (keep only the last N backup sets per source).

Core concepts:

  • Sources: each source represents a folder where backup files are created (UpdraftPlus, BackWPup, … or custom).
  • Upload: the plugin scans sources for backup files and uploads them to Nextcloud.
  • Schedule: optional daily/weekly/monthly runs at a fixed time (WordPress Cron; traffic-dependent).
  • Rotation: keep the newest N backup sets and remove older ones on Nextcloud.
  • Email Reporting: get notified on successful or failed transfers.

Features

  • Nextcloud WebDAV connection (URL, username, app password)
  • Multiple backup sources (known plugins + custom)
  • File filters by extension
  • Manual upload with progress modal
  • Scheduled runs: Daily, Weekly, or Monthly (WordPress Cron)
  • Email notifications for successful/failed transfers
  • Logs viewer + clear logs
  • Rotation / retention (keep last N backup sets)
  • German / English admin UI

Usage

Configure Nextcloud

  1. Enter your WebDAV base URL (must end with /).
  2. Enter username + Nextcloud App Password.
  3. Set a target folder name.
  4. Click Save & Test.

Configure sources

  1. Enable one or more sources.
  2. Adjust local paths (if needed).
  3. Set file extensions to include (comma-separated).

Schedule + rotation

  • Enable the schedule and set a time.
  • Enable rotation and choose how many backup sets to keep.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2.0 or later.

Assets:

  • Logo + flag icons are shipped as SVG assets in assets/img/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Luzid Backup to Nextcloud.
  3. Go to WP Admin → Luzid WP Tools → Backup to Nextcloud.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create backups?

No. It uploads backup archives created by other tools. Configure your backup plugin first.

Why does the schedule not run exactly on time?

WordPress Cron is traffic-based. If the site has no visits around the scheduled time, the run may be delayed.

Should I use a normal password or an app password?

Use a Nextcloud App Password.

1.2.9

  • WordPress.org Review Compliance – all review team requirements addressed
  • Fixed: Removed invalid Author URI (luzid.app)
  • Fixed: Contributors changed from “luzid” to “luzidmedia”
  • Fixed: Replaced WP_CONTENT_DIR constant with wp_normalize_path( dirname( wp_upload_dir()['basedir'] ) )
  • Fixed: $_POST is no longer processed as a whole; explicit field extraction in render_admin_page() and save_and_test_connection()
  • Fixed: JavaScript object name luzidBackup renamed to luzid_backup_data (prefixed)
  • Fixed: All global variables in admin-page.php prefixed with luzid_btn_
  • Fixed: Added proper phpcs:ignore annotations with justifications for display-only $_GET usage
  • Fixed: $_GET['test_result'] now sanitized with sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash() )
  • Security: webdav_password sanitized via sanitize_text_field() before processing
  • Security: Nested $_POST['sources'] array sanitized via map_deep() with sanitize_text_field

1.2.4

  • CRITICAL FIX: Settings now save correctly on first install
  • Fixed: active_tab defaults to ‘tab-nextcloud’ instead of empty string
  • Fixed: WebDAV credentials and settings persist after “Save & Test”
  • Improved: Better fallback handling for tab detection

1.2.3

  • CRITICAL: Replaced cURL with wp_remote_request() for WordPress compliance
  • Fixed: parse_url() replaced with wp_parse_url()
  • Fixed: File upload now uses WordPress HTTP API instead of cURL/fopen
  • Fixed: Added phpcs:ignore for remaining display-only $_GET usage
  • Performance: Increased timeout to 300s for large file uploads
  • Compliance: 100% WordPress.org Plugin Check compliant (no ERRORs)

1.2.2

  • Fixed: All date() replaced with gmdate() for timezone safety
  • Fixed: All wp_redirect() replaced with wp_safe_redirect()
  • Fixed: Added wp_unslash() before sanitize_text_field() everywhere
  • Fixed: Added phpcs:ignore comments for legitimate nonce-free $_GET usage
  • Compliance: Fully WordPress.org Plugin Check compliant

1.2.1

  • Initial public release
  • Core Features:
    • Automatic backup uploads to Nextcloud via WebDAV
    • Multiple backup source support (UpdraftPlus, BackWPup, etc.)
    • Schedule options: Daily, Weekly, Monthly with custom times
    • Automatic rotation/retention: Keep last N backups
    • Email notifications for successful/failed transfers
    • Real-time upload progress tracking
    • Comprehensive logging system
  • Security & Compliance:
    • WordPress.org coding standards compliant
    • Proper nonce verification and data sanitization
    • Secure credential storage
    • ABSPATH protection on all files
  • User Experience:
    • German and English interface
    • Detailed HowTo guides with screenshots
    • Conflict resolution for backup files
    • Easy WebDAV configuration and testing

1.2.0

  • Beta release for testing
  • Changed: Tab “Nextcloud” renamed to “Setup”
  • Added: Email Reporting feature with success/error notifications
  • Changed: “Rotation” heading renamed to “Anzahl Backups” (DE) / “Backup Retention” (EN)
  • Fixed: Cron scheduling now properly reschedules after each run (important for weekly/monthly)
  • Fixed: Rotation now logs detailed information for troubleshooting
  • Updated: Support email changed to lz-btn@luzid-media.com

1.2.8

  • Added: Schedule frequency options (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
  • Fixed: Upload modal now shows “You can close the window now” when complete
  • Added: Complete German and English HowTo documentation
  • Fixed: JavaScript code compliance for WordPress.org (wp_add_inline_script)
  • Improved: Schedule Cron calculations for weekly and monthly backups

1.2.7

  • Fixed: Checkbox values (Sources/Schedule/Rotation) are now parsed robustly, so only selected options are stored (no accidental “all enabled”).

1.2.6

  • Fixed: “Settings saved” modal is now styled like the Content Scheduler modal (OK button, backdrop click, ESC to close).
  • Fixed: Tab selection is now persisted correctly (active_tab), preventing unintended resets when saving.
  • Fixed: Backup sources, schedule and rotation checkboxes are now reliably saved (unchecked stays off).
  • Changed: Backup source fields are no longer greyed out when a source is inactive (only “Aktiviert” controls whether it is used).

1.2.4

  • Fixed: Backup sources are now disabled by default on first install.
  • Fixed: Source enable/disable state is now reliably persisted after saving.
  • Added: Hint in the Nextcloud tab if no backup source has been selected yet.
  • Improved: Clarified what “Scan real files only” does.
  • Improved: Settings saved feedback now uses a centered modal (consistent with other Luzid plugins).
  • Improved: Form field styling (select/input) adjusted to avoid clipped text.

1.2.2

  • Changed: Admin UI branding aligned with other Luzid WP Tools plugins (header, tabs, styling).
  • Changed: Language switcher uses SVG assets from assets/img/ (no inline data-URI).
  • Changed: Unified admin CSS to shared assets/css/luzid.css.
  • Added: WordPress-standard readme.txt.

1.2.1

  • Previous release.
